info.name: Tequipy Collections Sandbox
info.description: Run discovery separately, fill variables, then run folders 2–7 once in order. Creates four collections: two COMPLETED and two CANCELLED. Devices 1 and 2 become ACTIVE in company storage at a Tequipy warehouse on COMPLETE; devices 3 and 4 remain with their original employees. Folders 2–7 do not create a redeployment; the additional folder 9 completes two subsequent redeployments. Folders 7–9 add extended checks. Folder 8 is skipped without another-company record.
